llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render modal gesture content under `GestureHandlerRootView` (or `gestureHandlerRootHOC`) in the `Modal` subtree for Android gesture handling.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No GestureHandlerRootView or gestureHandlerRootHOC wrapping the Modal subtree. The Modal content is wrapped only by PanGestureHandler.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Modal content must include an RNGH gesture control using `Gesture.*` (for example `Gesture.Pan()`) attached with `GestureDetector`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy PanGestureHandler component instead of the required Gesture.Pan() builder API attached via GestureDetector.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement modal gesture logic with current RNGH builder callbacks (`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy onHandlerStateChange callback and Animated.event instead of the required onUpdate/onEnd builder callbacks. useAnimatedGestureHandler is not used, but the required new API is also absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onEnd` must use `CLOSE_THRESHOLD` to decide between modal dismiss and snap-back.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CLOSE_THRESHOLD check exists but is inside the legacy onHandlerStateChange handler, not inside a Pan onEnd builder callback as required.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Dismiss state updates from gesture/worklet context must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No scheduleOnRN call anywhere in the file. State updates (setVisible) are called directly in a JS callback, not from a worklet context.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: GestureDetector and its gesture-driven modal sheet must remain descendants of the modal `GestureHandlerRootView` boundary (no detached modal gesture path).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No GestureHandlerRootView boundary exists in the Modal subtree; GestureDetector is not used at all, so the required containment hierarchy is entirely absent.
evidence: Modal contains only PanGestureHandler, no GestureHandlerRootView or GestureDetector
